title: Restaurant General Manager – Café
description:
Restaurant General Manager – Café

**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Industry:** Café / Food \& Beverage  
**Work Schedule:** Flexible – including evenings, weekends and holidays

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced and dynamic **Restaurant General Manager** to lead the overall operations of a café. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing daily operations, leading and developing the team, maintaining excellent customer service, controlling costs, and driving sales and profitability.

This is a hands\-on leadership role suited for someone who has strong experience in the **café, restaurant, coffee shop, or F\&B industry** and enjoys working in a fast\-paced, customer\-focused environment.

Key ResponsibilitiesCafé Operations

* Manage the day\-to\-day operations of the café.
* Ensure smooth opening and closing procedures.
* Develop and implement SOPs to maintain consistent service and quality.
* Maintain a clean, organized, welcoming and customer\-friendly café environment.
* Monitor operational efficiency and identify areas for improvement.

Team Leadership

* Lead, motivate and manage the café team, including Shift Managers and Assistant Managers.
* Train and develop employees to deliver excellent service.
* Build a positive, accountable and team\-oriented work culture.
* Support recruitment, onboarding and employee retention.
* Monitor staff performance and ensure adequate manpower during all shifts.

Customer Experience

* Ensure high standards of customer service and product quality.
* Handle customer feedback, complaints and service issues professionally.
* Monitor service standards and implement improvements.
* Focus on customer satisfaction and repeat business.

Inventory \& Cost Control

* Manage inventory levels and ensure timely ordering of supplies.
* Coordinate with suppliers and maintain good vendor relationships.
* Conduct regular inventory checks and minimize wastage.
* Monitor food and beverage costs and implement cost\-control measures.
* Support menu and product improvement based on customer preferences and market trends.

Sales \& Financial Management

* Monitor daily sales, revenue and operational expenses.
* Oversee POS operations and daily cash reconciliation.
* Track sales performance and identify opportunities to increase revenue.
* Monitor P\&L, budgets and key business performance metrics.
* Prepare regular operational and sales reports for management.

Health, Safety \& Compliance

* Ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene and sanitation standards.
* Maintain a safe working environment for employees and customers.
* Conduct regular checks to ensure operational and hygiene standards are followed.
* Train staff on food safety and health \& safety procedures.

Business Growth

* Work with senior management to implement strategies for business growth.
* Identify opportunities to increase sales and customer retention.
* Support marketing and local community initiatives.
* Introduce new ideas to improve the café experience and operational performance.

Key Qualifications

* Proven experience as a **Restaurant Manager, Café Manager, General Manager or similar leadership role** in the F\&B industry.
* Experience in café, coffee shop, restaurant or QSR operations preferred.
* Strong team management and leadership skills.
* Good understanding of **P\&L, budgeting, sales analysis and cost control**.
* Experience in inventory management and supplier coordination.
* Strong customer service and problem\-solving skills.
* Knowledge of food safety, hygiene and sanitation standards.
* Ability to manage multiple operational activities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Hands\-on and proactive approach to café management.

Preferred Skills

* Experience managing Shift Managers / Assistant Managers.
* Familiarity with POS systems and restaurant management software.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to analyze sales and operational performance.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends and holidays.

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Branch Manager
description:
Job Title

**Branch Manager**

Industry

**NBFC / Financial Services**

Job Location

Branch Location

Reporting To

Regional Manager / Cluster Manager / Area Manager

Job Summary

The Branch Manager will be responsible for the overall management and performance of the branch, including business development, customer acquisition, team management, loan operations, collections, compliance, and achievement of branch targets. The role requires strong leadership, sales, operational, and customer relationship management skills.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Business Development \& Sales**

* Achieve branch\-wise monthly and annual business targets.
* Drive loan disbursement, gold loan, investment/NCD, insurance, and other assigned financial products.
* Generate new business through customer visits, referrals, local marketing, and business development activities.
* Develop and maintain relationships with existing and prospective customers.
* Monitor daily business performance and take corrective action to achieve targets.
* Identify new business opportunities within the branch's market area.

**2\. Branch Operations**

* Ensure smooth and efficient day\-to\-day branch operations.
* Monitor cash, gold, documents, registers, systems, and other branch assets.
* Ensure proper completion and verification of KYC and loan documentation.
* Maintain branch records and ensure timely submission of reports to the Regional/Head Office.
* Ensure adherence to company SOPs and operational guidelines.

**3\. Gold Loan Operations** *(where applicable)*

* Ensure proper gold appraisal, documentation, custody, and release procedures.
* Monitor gold loan outstanding, renewals, closures, auctions, and overdue accounts.
* Ensure compliance with prescribed gold\-loan procedures and security standards.
* Immediately report any discrepancy, suspected fraud, or spurious\-gold\-related issue to the concerned authority.

**4\. Team Management**

* Lead, motivate, and monitor branch staff to achieve business and operational targets.
* Allocate responsibilities and monitor individual employee performance.
* Conduct regular team meetings and performance reviews.
* Support recruitment, induction, training, and development of branch employees.
* Address employee performance and disciplinary issues in coordination with HR/Regional Management.

**5\. Customer Service**

* Maintain high standards of customer service and customer satisfaction.
* Handle customer complaints and ensure timely resolution.
* Build long\-term relationships with customers and improve customer retention.
* Ensure transparent communication of product terms, charges, interest rates, and applicable procedures.

**6\. Collections \& Recovery**

* Monitor overdue accounts and ensure timely follow\-up with customers.
* Coordinate with collection/recovery teams for overdue and NPA accounts.
* Conduct customer visits where required for recovery and business follow\-up.
* Ensure recovery activities are carried out in accordance with company policies and applicable regulations.

**7\. Compliance \& Risk Management**

* Ensure strict compliance with company policies, RBI guidelines, KYC/AML requirements, and applicable laws.
* Maintain proper branch records and documentation.
* Ensure audit observations are addressed within the prescribed timeline.
* Prevent operational lapses, fraud, and financial irregularities.
* Cooperate with internal, statutory, and regulatory audits and inspections.

**8\. Reporting \& Review**

* Submit daily, weekly, and monthly branch performance reports.
* Monitor key performance indicators including business growth, collections, customer acquisition, overdue/NPA, and staff productivity.
* Participate in review meetings with Cluster/Regional/Head Office teams.
* Take immediate corrective action when branch performance is below expectations.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Branch business achievement
* Loan disbursement and outstanding growth
* Gold loan business and portfolio quality
* Customer acquisition and retention
* Collection and recovery performance
* Reduction of overdue/NPA accounts
* Staff productivity and target achievement
* Audit and compliance performance
* Customer service and complaint resolution
* Branch profitability and operational efficiency

Required Qualifications

* Graduate degree in any discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Finance, Marketing, or related field will be an advantage.
* Experience in NBFC, banking, gold loan, microfinance, lending, or financial services preferred.

Required Experience

**3–7 years of relevant experience**, preferably with experience in branch management, sales, lending, collections, and team handling.

Key Skills

* Branch Operations Management
* Sales \& Business Development
* Team Leadership
* Customer Relationship Management
* Loan \& Gold Loan Operations
* Collection \& Recovery
* KYC/AML \& Compliance
* Problem Solving
* Communication \& Negotiation
* MIS \& Reporting
* Local Market Development

Personal Attributes

* Strong leadership and decision\-making ability
* Target\-oriented approach
* Customer\-focused attitude
* High level of integrity and accountability
* Good communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
* Willingness to travel locally for business and customer visits

Pay: Up to ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Integration Project Administrator
description:
**Overview**  

**Purpose:**  

  

The Platform Operations, Support, and Onboarding teams ensure the reliability, stability, and seamless functioning of CitrusAd's production systems and offerings, operating as a centre of excellence for service delivery across the integration lifecycle.
  

  

The Integration Project Administrator, based in Epsilon India, provides administrative and coordination support to Integration Project Managers across the APJ, EMEA, and AMER portfolios. The role keeps integration projects on track, ensures administrative tasks are completed accurately and on time, and contributes to the standardisation of integration delivery globally. The position extends 24/5 coverage of integration delivery by adding an India working\-day footprint to the existing AU, US and UK presence.
  

**Core Objectives**  

* Project Coordination
* Operational Practices
* Stakeholder Engagement
* System Reliability
* Product Knowledge
* Team Membership
* Technical Developments, Process Improvement and Simplification
* Personal Capability Building

  

Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice.
  

  

**Responsibilities**  

**Project Coordination**
  

* Assist in planning, organising, and coordinating integration projects, including scheduling meetings, updating project tasks, maintaining project calendars, and ensuring goals and deadlines are met.
* Create, organise, and maintain project documentation, including project plans, scope documents, reports, and meeting minutes in ServiceNow and SharePoint.
* Track resource availability and utilisation across project team members; flag conflicts to the Director and Integration Project Managers.
* Serve as a central point of contact for project\-related communication across India, AU, UK, and US time zones; distribute information, schedule cross\-region meetings, and keep partners informed.
* Prepare and present reports on project progress, RAID logs, and onboarding Retun on Investment data.
* Assist Integration Project Managers in managing budget, scope, and delivery.
* Identify project risks and impacts to timelines; coordinate mitigation activities with the Integration Project Manager.
* Support the service transition into Platform Operations for technical support of clients post\-launch.
* Uphold processes and procedures for the best change management across production platforms.

  

**Operational Practices**
  

* Uphold operational practices for software implementation and project management.
* Support proactive incident and problem detection during integration and hypercare phases.
* Support the operational integrity of all production environments.
* Work as a team to ensure SLAs and practices are well defined, documented, and consistently applied.
* Uphold the IT Service and Support workflow, with a particular focus on best\-in\-class customer experience.

  

**Stakeholder Engagement**
  

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams across Client Integration Engineering, Product, Release Management, Platform Operations, and Global Support.
* Maintain strong relationships with retailers and partners, ensuring their needs are met while protecting the business needs of CitrusAd and Epsilon.
* Act as a regional point of contact for India\-based retailers and India\-based engineering and account teams.

  

**System Reliability**
  

* Work with Engineering, Product, Delivery, and Security teams to ensure appropriate attention is given to production and system reliability for customers.
* Uphold operational practices in conjunction with Product and Engineering teams, including understanding how integrations and configurations may affect reliability, performance, and cost.

  

**Product Knowledge**
  

* Keep up to date with Epsilon Retail Media product suite features, improvements, and roadmap.
* Stay abreast of industry trends in retail media, ad\-tech, and advertising in India and globally.
* Understand the different facets of the CitrusAd system, including Reporting, Ad Serving, API Integration, Product Catalog, and Ad Placements.
* Maintain a solid level of knowledge of the technical integration and functionality of Epsilon and CitrusAd Onsite and Offsite core platforms, supporting products, toolsets, and partner systems.

  

**Team Membership**
  

* Act in the best interest of the Customer and the Team at all times.
* Drive cohesion between team members across India, AU, UK, and US; build strong relationships across the Platform Operations and Support group.
* Collaborate with internal delivery teams to ensure a high\-quality customer experience for case resolution and support.

  

**Technical Developments, Process Improvement and Simplification**
  

* Ensure all processes and procedures are documented for continuous improvement.
* Identify and implement process improvement and simplification with leadership and partner teams.
* Proactively identify new opportunities to improve and simplify integration delivery, tooling, and governance.

  

**Personal Capability Building**
  

* Develop own capabilities through assessment, development planning, and formal and informal training and coaching.
* Gain or maintain external professional accreditation where relevant.
* Maintain an in\-depth understanding of project management methodologies, technology, external regulation, and industry standard.

**Behavioural Competencies**  

* **Manages complexity.** Detail oriented, strong communication and negotiation skills, works well under pressure, prioritises effectively, and handles multiple inquiries concurrently. Makes sense of complex, high\-volume, sometimes contradictory information.
* **Ensures accountability.** Holds self and others accountable to meet commitments; tracks performance and helps the team learn from success, failure, and feedback.
* **Balances partners.** Anticipates and balances the needs of multiple collaborators across regions; maintains a professional attitude under pressure.
* **Collaborates.** Builds partnerships and works collaboratively to meet shared objectives; shares credit and invites candid views.
* **Instills trust.** Gains the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity.
* **Courage.** Steps up to address difficult issues; raises tough issues with leadership early.
* **Influences.** Uses compelling arguments to gain support and commitment; deftly explains impacts to internal teams.
* **Contributes to effective team behaviours.** Applies diverse skills to achieve common goals; leverages strengths and addresses weaknesses.

  

**Qualifications**  

**Essential**
  

* 2\+ years' experience as a project administrator or project coordinator in a technical or software implementation environment.
* Strong technical competence and ability to understand complex software systems.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; able to work upward to senior leadership and across a wide range of audiences.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced, dynamic, globally distributed environment.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills; able to dive deep while keeping perspective on big\-picture goals.
* Ability to engage and coordinate teams within tight timeframes and manage multiple concurrent projects.
* Self\-directed, motivated, and able to multitask in a fast\-paced ad\-technology environment.
* Ability to work flexible hours to overlap with AU and UK or US time zones as needed.
* Fluent written and spoken English.

  

**Desirable**
  

* Proficiency in ServiceNow, particularly Project Portfolio Management or Strategic Portfolio Management modules.
* Experience with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and Teams in a global delivery context.
* Experience working with retail media, ad\-tech, or e\-commerce platforms.
* Familiarity with data privacy regulations such as the DPDP Act 2023 (India) and GDPR.

**Education**  

  

**Essential**
  

* An undergraduate degree in Project Management, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or equivalent industry experience.

  

**Desirable**
  

* Professional Project Management accreditation, Agile or PMI or similar, and/or demonstrated work experience as a project coordinator or administrator.
* ITIL Foundation certified.

  

**Additional Information**  

Epsilon is a global data, technology and services company that powers the marketing and advertising ecosystem. For decades, we've provided marketers from the world's leading brands the data, technology and services they need to engage consumers with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 1 View of their universe of potential buyers. 1 Vision for engaging each individual. And 1 Voice to harmonize engagement across paid, owned and earned channels.  

  

Epsilon's comprehensive portfolio of capabilities across our suite of digital media, messaging and loyalty solutions bridge the divide between marketing and advertising technology. We process 400\+ billion consumer actions each day using advanced AI and hold many patents of proprietary technology, including real\-time modeling languages and consumer privacy advancements. Thanks to the work of every employee, Epsilon has been consistently recognized as industry\-leading by Forrester, Adweek and the MRC. Epsilon is a global company with more than 9,000 employees around the world.

* **Collaboration:** We work together, support one another, and collectively achieve goals.

* **Innovation:** We drive progress through cutting\-edge solutions and forward\-thinking approaches.
* **Flexibility:** We've created a balance between work and personal life, and we encourage adaptability to solve problems creatively.

  

Our values guide us to create value for our clients, our people and consumers.

These pillars and values are our foundation\-shaping our culture, guiding our decisions, and uniting us in common purpose.

title: Director- Marketing
description:
We are **Infrrd** , an Enterprise AI company helping global enterprises extract data from complex, unstructured documents like invoices, contracts, engineering drawings, and handwritten notes. Our AI goes beyond data extraction to automate end\-to\-end workflows, reducing manual effort, improving accuracy, and accelerating business operations.  



  

  

Our product is proven, enterprise customers are live, and we're ready to scale. We're looking for a **Director – Marketing** to bring strategic direction, sharper execution, and stronger business impact to our marketing function.  



  

  

You'll work closely with the founders, Sales leadership, and our existing marketing team to define
  

where we play, who we target, how we position Infrrd, and how marketing drives pipeline and growth. You'll provide the strategy and direction while empowering the team to execute.  



  

  

**What You'll Own**

* Set and drive the overall marketing strategy aligned with business, GTM, and revenue objectives.
* Provide strategic direction to our existing Demand Generation team, helping sharpen targeting, channel strategy, campaign priorities, and performance.
* Partner closely with Sales to define and refine our ICP, target segments, personas, buyer journeys, and account strategy.
* Develop an integrated demand and growth strategy across inbound, ABM, digital, content, events, and other relevant channels.
* Own marketing's contribution to pipeline growth, with clear metrics, priorities, and accountability.
Identify opportunities across the funnel and improve awareness engagement qualified demand pipeline* revenue.
* Shape our product marketing, positioning, and messaging, translating complex Enterprise AI capabilities into compelling stories for enterprise buyers.
* Strengthen Infrrd's brand and market presence through content, customer stories, thought leadership, website, and industry initiatives.
* Work with Sales on sales enablement, messaging, account engagement, and pipeline acceleration.
* Establish the right KPIs, attribution, and reporting to measure marketing effectiveness and guide investment.
* Build strong collaboration across Marketing, Sales, Product, and Leadership.
Develop existing marketing talent and help evolve the organization as the company scales.  
* 

  

  

**What We're Looking For**

* 10–15 years of experience in B2B marketing in B2B SaaS, Enterprise SaaS, AI, or technology companies.
* Proven experience in a marketing leadership role, setting strategy across multiple marketing functions.
* Strong background in demand generation and growth marketing, with a track record of influencing pipeline and revenue.
* Experience partnering with Sales leadership on ICP, GTM strategy, segmentation, and pipeline growth.
* Strong understanding of enterprise B2B buying journeys, complex sales cycles, and ABM.
* Experience across areas such as demand generation, product marketing, content, digital, brand, and events.
* Strong analytical and commercial mindset, with the ability to connect marketing activity to business outcomes.
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex technology into compelling business value.
* A strategic thinker who is also comfortable getting into the details when needed.
* Strong people leadership and mentoring skills, with the ability to provide direction, develop talent, and build the function as we scale.
Experience in Enterprise AI, Intelligent Document Processing (IDP), Document Automation, or Enterprise SaaS is a strong plus.  
* 

  

  

**Why Join Us**

* Shape the marketing strategy for an Enterprise AI company at a defining stage of growth.
* Work closely with the founders and executive leadership and influence company strategy.
* Lead and provide direction to an existing marketing team and help take its impact to the next level.
* Work on meaningful GTM challenges at the intersection of AI, enterprise software, and complex workflows.
* Have a direct connection between your work and pipeline, growth, and business outcomes.
Join a culture where ideas are welcomed, ownership is real, and challenging the status quo is encouraged.  
* 

  

Think you're excited by the challenge? We'd love to hear from you.  



  

By submitting your application, you agree that your personal information and resume may be collected, processed, and stored by us for recruitment purposes, including consideration for future roles.
